name: Pradeep Rath,

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Pradeep Rath writes poetry, drama, criticism and travelogues alongside a career in public service. A Literary Vibes contributor note records his retirement from the Indian Administrative Service in 2017. His literary interests range from modern Odia writing and a comparative study of Upendra Bhanja and Shakespeare to accounts of travel in Europe and America. His English poetry collection is titled The Glistening Sky.

“Iridescent Layers” moves between waking and the presence of someone who seems to return through memory. Mango groves, riverbanks and a vast blue sky hold moments of playfulness and lost love. As the figure dissolves, the speaker’s effort to grasp an empty moment gives the poem its lingering ache.
